name: farmexit
description: FarmExit: public website (web/), admin dashboard (dashboard/), NestJS API (api/). Each app has its own package-lock.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix dashboard ci && npm --prefix api ci
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:api
scripts.deploy:api: node -e "console.error('Backend deployment is blocked. See docs/FARMEXIT_PRODUCTION_BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md; no build, restart, or seed was run.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:dashboard && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:dashboard && npm run lint:api
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix web run format:check && npm --prefix dashboard run format:check && npm --prefix api run format:check
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:api:e2e && npm run test:web && npm run test:dashboard
